source_message.text: By default, the level shifter was designated DNP (Do Not Populate), leaving only its footprint on the PCB with no components soldered. It was included for future-proofing: if someone later attached a 10V-logic sensor to the spare I2C0 or UART connectors, populating the BSS138s would allow it to work. Every sensor in the current BOM operates with 3.3V logic, including SPS30 and ZE08, which are 10V-powered but compatible with 3.3V logic, so none of the connected sensors needs the level shifter. You can omit it completely to save board space. If 10V-logic sensors are ever required later, we will add a small adapter board instead of reserving permanent footprints.
